row:
Welcome to our channel!  Dr. Josh here, and we are all about helping you get out of pain so that you can get back to the things you love!   We emphasize sports and rehab injuries with a specific focus on Jiu-Jitsu, Wrestling, and judo.

Get Our Low Back Pain Guide:
https://go.sandiegosportsrehab.com/back-pain-guide

We know you love jiu-jitsu, and we want you to stay on the mats training. Unfortunately, injuries happen but we are here to help.

It's not just about showing you pain relief videos or exercises... It's about truly improving your health, mobility, and strength, & education so you know can level up your health!  We will show you REAL things that make a difference in your recovery & performance so that you can start feeling better right away!  Dr. Josh is a Sports Chiropractor, BJJ Black belt, & has been in practice since 2010.   So no matter where you stand, we are here to help. 
See you soon!
